drone.candidate_composition: Oyunohara torii and Kumano River valley, only if site-owner written permission and all MLIT/NPA legal checks permit
drone.no_fly_assumption: Do not fly near shrine/temple grounds, waterfall/crowds or over people without explicit legal and site permission.
drone.national_park_rule: Ministry of Environment guidance says drone flight and take-off/landing alone generally do not require an application/notification under the Natural Parks Act, but land/facility managers can prohibit flight; avoid wildlife, concentrated visitors, paths, lodging and open-air baths. River/waterfall management rules and national-forest entry procedures may also apply.

kumano_national_park_contact.instruction: Provide exact take-off/landing coordinates, date, time, altitude and planned route; confirm jurisdiction and any site-owner permissions.

no_fly_sites_without_written_site_permis: World Heritage core trail and managed facilities along the route
drone.operational_rule: Do not take off from or fly over these shrine/temple/managed areas unless the relevant land or facility manager has given prior written permission and all MLIT/NPA legal checks are satisfied. This is a site-permission restriction, not a claim that all such places are categorically designated no-fly airspace under aviation law.

credential_options.before_first_stamp: Before collecting the first stamp, obtain one accepted Kumano stamp record per pilgrim. The free Dual Pilgrim Credential is the confirmed, recommended option.

option_a.name: Free Dual Pilgrim Credential
option_a.instructions: Use the Kumano side for the 10 required stamps. Stamp Kumano Hongu Taisha in both the route-list position (stamp 05) and the first-page COMPLETION OF PILGRIMAGE field on the Kumano side.

option_b.name: A specific Tourist Association-issued stamp booklet accepted under official FAQ Q2
option_b.instructions: The official FAQ allows a Tourist Association-issued stamp booklet for the Kumano side when paired with a Santiago Cathedral-recognized Camino credential. The FAQ does not make every stamp book eligible. Before using one, send its cover and inside pages to the Tanabe City Kumano Tourism Bureau and obtain confirmation that this exact booklet and its stamp fields qualify.

not_eligible_substitute.name: Wakayama Prefecture Nakahechi stamp booklet (41 stamps, JPY 100)
not_eligible_substitute.instructions: This is a separate Wakayama Prefecture stamp campaign. The Tanabe City Kumano Tourism Bureau explicitly states that completion of this booklet does NOT qualify for Dual Pilgrim certification. Do not use it as the backup credential.

credential_options.stock_note: Ask Comfort Hotel Kii Tanabe before arrival whether it can obtain and hold two free Dual Pilgrim Credentials.
